title: Formula for Retarding Force due to the Viscosity
text: To calculate the retarding force due to the viscosity of the air layer, use the formula for viscous drag force: $$F=\frac{\eta{}Av}{d}.$$ The viscosity of air at $$20**\circ\text{C}$$ is about $$\eta=1.81\times10**{-5}\,\text{Pa}\cdot\text{s}$$.
